content.text: Excellent! The Researcher Agent demonstrated remarkable creative capability in developing a truly novel concept. Now let me test the Planner Agent's creative capabilities by asking it to design an implementation strategy for this innovative concept:

input.task: Design a creative and innovative implementation strategy for the Digital Empathy Engine concept, including: (1) A phased rollout that starts with a surprising/unconventional market entry, (2) Creative funding mechanisms that go beyond traditional VC (think empathy-backed currencies, impact bonds, etc.), (3) Novel partnership strategies with unexpected collaborators, (4) Innovative user acquisition approaches that embody empathy principles, (5) Creative business models that align profit with empathy development, and (6) Disruptive go-to-market strategies that challenge conventional tech company launches. Think beyond standard business planning - be genuinely creative and innovative in your approach.
